subject: Maths

lane_shape.grammar: site-native chapter slug: {as|a-level}-{strand}-{n}-{name} (Year 1 chapters carry the `as-` prefix, Year 2 the `a-level-` prefix)
lane_shape.granularity_of_record: per-chapter question sets — MathsGenie publishes A-Level exam questions as compiled per-chapter sets; subtopic pages carry no question PDFs (video/lesson only)

sibling_lane_overlap.as-level-maths-edexcel: its 24 chapters are slug-identical to the Year-1 half of this lane (verified at run time); its question resources are the same 24 old-site question sets — a future AS lane extraction would duplicate content of this lane; dedup decision recorded here, AS lane NOT extracted twice

modes_absent.note: 245 subtopic pages carry video/lesson only; the new-site subtopic question bank is an interactive client-side feature (link-of-record per subtopic page)
A-Level lane has no booklet generation (that is a GCSE/IGCSE mode)
other MG-* planes; not in the QuestionBank scope
operator decision 2026-11-07: no past-paper PDFs anywhere in MG-*; link-of-record remains the site

numbering_law.rule: printed total-line number is the question identity; non-monotonic dips are position-derived and flagged printed_as (source typos); ascending gaps are kept as printed and recorded (never renumbered silently, never padded)

discovery_provenance.rule: question-set pages that publish only the answers link; the sibling question PDF follows the site's own asset-host naming convention ({stem}.pdf beside {stem}ans.pdf) and was HEAD-200-verified at run time before inclusion

scope_exclusions: past-paper banks (papers/past) — operator decision 2026-11-07: no paper PDFs
mini-tests — same decision; live-site interactive, link-of-record only
old-spec (C1-C4/S1/M1) A-Level materials (old.mathsgenie.co.uk/alevel.php) — different qualification generation, out of the 9MA0 lane of record

drift_vs_run000.note: run-000 recorded the lane's 44 chapters as its topic set; this run adds the 245-subtopic layer decoded from the lane payload (finer than run-000 recorded)

provenance.source_pdfs: fetched, processed, discarded — only sha256 + URL survive per chapter
provenance.licensing: MathsGenie site content is third-party material; operator attestation in ../LICENSE-DATA.md (Amendment 2026-11-07)
